items.name: Higher degree research supervision
items.blurb: Doctoral and masters supervision in groundwater management, irrigation, water quality and water governance. Recent co-authored work with research students spans village groundwater cooperatives, drought dynamics in western Rajasthan, cadmium uptake in hydroponic and soil systems, and water sustainability assessment frameworks.

items.name: Transdisciplinary training design
items.blurb: Designing and evaluating training that crosses disciplines — the Young Water Professionals programme, water policy labs, and the dam safety programme — and publishing on what makes such training work rather than assuming it does.

items.name: Field-based capacity building
items.blurb: Training village volunteers and water professionals in the field: groundwater monitoring, well observation and the shared record-keeping that lets a community act on what it measures.
